title: Elasticsearch connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One Elasticsearch connector instance's settings: the cluster URL, the index, the source's scroll window and the sink's bulk size. Loams renders both Iggy plugin configs from this one instance (design §33 §8 row 11; CN1 plan Task 10), so it covers the source and the sink. `basic.password` and `api_key` resolve through the namespace's secret store (D189) and are exactly the manifest's `secrets` list. The `key` property is required because the manifest declares capabilities.sink.upsert: true (CN1 Task 1's semantic rule); it is also the document _id the upsert and the delete use.

url.description: The cluster base URL. A Loams collection's ES gateway endpoint works unchanged (§33 §8 row 11).

basic.description: HTTP basic auth (the manifest's `basic` auth slug).

password.description: The basic-auth password. Resolved through the secret store (D189); the rendered Iggy config reads it from a mounted file.

api_key.description: An API key, base64 of id:api_key. Resolved through the secret store (D189); the rendered Iggy config reads it from a mounted file.

key.description: The sink's upsert key: the field whose value becomes the document _id. Required because the manifest declares capabilities.sink.upsert: true (CN1 Task 1's semantic rule).

flush_interval_ms.description: How often a partial bulk is flushed.

scroll.description: The source's scroll or point-in-time window.

keep_alive.description: How long a scroll stays open, as a duration string.

sort.description: The sort field the point-in-time read orders on; it must be unique and stable, and it is the source's position.

apply_deletes.description: Apply deletes for events carrying loamsop = d, as a delete by _id.

tls.description: TLS material for an https:// URL.

verify_full.description: Whether the server certificate's hostname is verified.
